summary: The generic base-change results were correctly hoisted into BaseChange.lean, but three of the integral-lattice consequences (real basis, injectivity, range = ZSpan) are proved at the ℤ→ℝ special case although they are instances of general facts — one of which already exists in Mathlib. One statement is also weaker than the proof that supports it.
